newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-RICHMOND CONFIRM TALKS WITH SOUTH AFRICANS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-RICHMOND CONFIRM TALKS WITH SOUTH AFRICANS.

text.p: Ambitious second division English club Richmond confirmed on Wednesday they are negotiating with South African rugby union players Cabous van der Westhuizen and Steve Atherton to join them.
Richmond's coaching director John Kingston said discussions were still at an early stage.
"We enjoyed the benefit of talks with them. We already have a very good side, but they are both quality players and we could be interested. Maybe sooner rather than later," Richmond said.
"We shall hope to hear from them again after they return to South Africa this week."
Wing van der Westhuizen and lock Atherton flew to England to test the market for their services after helping Natal to their Currie Cup final victory over Transvaal last Saturday.
Other English clubs are also interested. Champions Bath are interested in Atherton, while van der Westhuizen, Natal's all-time record try scorer with 81, appeals to current league leaders Harlequins.
